newsitem.title: UK: Scottish economy to outperform UK in 1997-report.
newsitem.headline: Scottish economy to outperform UK in 1997-report.

text.p: The Scottish economy will outperform the overall UK economy in 1997, but the situation will reversed in 1998, Strathclyde University's Fraser of Allander Institute said on Thursday.

Scottish GDP is forecast to rise by 3.5 percent in 1997 compared with 3.25 percent in the UK. Robust consumer spending in Scotland and a strong performance by the country's electronics sector will drive growth higher.
"Together they will account for the absolute and relative improvement in Scotland's economic performance next year," the institute said.
In 1998, GDP is forecast to grow by 3.25 percent while growth in the UK overall will accelerate to 3.5 percent, it said.
